blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eli Soyud erupted for 30 points in Akari’s come-from-behind 25-22, 25-27, 22-25, 25-23, 15-12 win over Farm Fresh in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Soyud finished with 27 kills, two blocks, and an ace, including the game-winning backrow hit to complete the Chargers’ second straight win, tying the Foxies with identical 2-2 records. With the fifth set tied at 11, Trisha Tubu missed her serve before Mars Alba scored on a kill off a floating ball and Fifi Sharma followed with a kill block to give Akari match point at […]...
